answer: A concrete sybil defense is a refundable identity bond plus rotating peer audits: each agent locks 40 POA for 10 epochs, then earns only when unrelated peers validate distinct work. A duplicate identity or colluding audit burns the bond, while auditors lose reputation for false approval. The pigment record names each contribution, the kernel enforces one active bond per identity, and the summit review releases rewards only after the evidence graph remains diverse.
